You are implementing a UI change in a Next.js 16 + shadcn (style "base-nova", built on @base-ui/react, NOT radix) + Tailwind v4 app.

WORK ONLY in this git worktree: /Users/itsmeyaw/projects/binden/.worktrees/ui-polish (branch `ui/request-table`, already checked out). Do not touch /Users/itsmeyaw/projects/binden itself. Do not switch branches, do not push.

Tooling: `pnpm`/`pnpm exec` refuse to run here (node_modules is a symlink outside the worktree). Use `npx shadcn@latest add <name>` (verify files land in the worktree's src/components/ui and package.json/lockfile stay unchanged; report any new dep), and `./node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit` (run `./node_modules/.bin/next typegen` first if PageProps types are missing), `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --deny-warnings .`, `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --write .`. Generated shadcn files that trip oxlint a11y rules may get a file-level `/* oxlint-disable <rule> */` like src/components/ui/input-group.tsx does.

Rules: shadcn components + Tailwind utilities only, never custom CSS. No new npm deps (do NOT add @tanstack/react-table; plain array filtering is enough). Minimal, boring code; no unrequested abstractions. Preserve accessible names used by tests/review.spec.ts: heading "Sign up requests"; each applicant's full name ("Given Family") must be a role=link to `/review/<id>`; link "Back to requests" in review-request.tsx; requests with non-reviewable statuses never appear (server already filters).

CURRENT STATE: src/components/review-workspace.tsx renders a split pane (ReviewQueue list on the left, ReviewRequest detail on the right on lg). src/components/review-queue.tsx fetches `/api/review/requests` client-side and renders a plain list. src/app/review/loading.tsx mirrors the split pane. src/components/review-request.tsx shows "Back to requests" only below lg (`lg:hidden`) and has an "unselected" state. Status labels for progress statuses live in `statusLabels` in src/components/review-progress.tsx. Read the API fields in src/lib/review.ts (`reviewRequestFields`) to see what each list item contains (e.g. workspaceEmail).

TASK:
1. Layout: drop the split pane. `/review` shows the requests table full width; `/review/[id]` shows only the request detail full width (in a constrained readable width, e.g. `mx-auto w-full max-w-4xl`), with "Back to requests" always visible (remove `lg:hidden`, render it as a ghost/outline small Button link like today). Simplify ReviewWorkspace accordingly (or have the two pages render ReviewQueue / ReviewRequest directly and delete review-workspace.tsx if that's simpler — pick the smaller diff). Keep the "Sign up requests" heading + description on the list page. Remove the now-unreachable "unselected" state from review-request.tsx only if it becomes dead code. Update src/app/review/loading.tsx to a matching skeleton for the list page (heading, toolbar, and a few Skeleton rows; add shadcn `skeleton` already exists).
2. Add shadcn `table` (and `empty` for the empty states) via CLI.
3. Rewrite ReviewQueue as a searchable, filterable table:
   - Toolbar above the table: an InputGroup (src/components/ui/input-group.tsx) with a lucide SearchIcon addon, `type="search"`, aria-label "Search requests", placeholder "Search by name or email…", filtering case-insensitively on given+family name, contactEmail, and workspaceEmail. Next to it a shadcn Select (src/components/ui/select.tsx, base-ui API — check how group-membership-picker.tsx uses it) with aria-label "Filter by status": "All statuses" plus one item per status present in the data (or all statuses), each showing a count, e.g. "Needs review (3)". Labels: verified → "Needs review", rejection_pending_notification → "Notification needs retrying", others from `statusLabels`. When search or filter is active show a ghost "Reset" button (XIcon) that clears both. Right-aligned muted text "Showing X of Y".
   - Table inside a `rounded-lg border` wrapper. Columns: Applicant (name as Link `font-medium hover:underline` + contact email muted underneath), Workspace email (hidden below md, muted, "—" if empty), Status (shadcn Badge: verified → default variant, rejection_pending_notification → destructive, handover_confirmed → secondary, everything else → outline), Submitted (hidden below sm, `new Date(createdAt).toLocaleDateString(undefined, { dateStyle: "medium" })`, right-aligned). Make the whole row feel clickable: `className="relative"` on the row and give the name Link an `after:absolute after:inset-0` overlay so clicking anywhere in the row navigates (keeps a single real link per row for a11y).
   - Empty states with the Empty component: no requests at all → "No signup requests" / "New requests will appear here once applicants submit the form."; no matches → "No matching requests" / "Try a different search or status." with a Reset button.
   - Loading: keep a Spinner/Skeleton loading state; access errors still render `<ReviewAccess outcome=... retry=... />`.
   - Keep the existing fetch logic and types.
4. Keep it client-side state (useState); do not sync to the URL.

VERIFY: tsc, oxlint, oxfmt pass. Also run `./node_modules/.bin/tsx tests/review.ts` if it doesn't need a DB (skip if it does, and say so). Commit in the worktree in 2-3 small commits with concise imperative messages (e.g. "Show review list and detail as separate full-width pages", "Render signup requests as a searchable, filterable table"). No Co-Authored-By trailers.

Report back: files changed, commit hashes, deviations, and anything you could not do.

content.text:
The review UI is now split into a full-width table page and a detail page, and the three commits are on `ui/request-table` in the worktree. `tsc`, `oxlint --deny-warnings` and `oxfmt --check` all pass. I did not run the Playwright spec or check the UI in a browser.

**Commits**
- `f327bcf` Show review list and detail as separate full-width pages
- `b64de39` Add shadcn table and empty components
- `1e91468` Render signup requests as a searchable, filterable table

**Files changed**
- `src/components/review-workspace.tsx`: deleted. Its split pane is gone.
- `src/app/review/page.tsx`: renders the "Sign up requests" heading and description, then `<ReviewQueue />`.
- `src/app/review/[id]/page.tsx`: renders `<ReviewRequest id key>` inside `mx-auto w-full max-w-4xl`. The `key` forces a remount when the id changes, as the old workspace did.
- `src/components/review-request.tsx`: `id` is now required. "Back to requests" is always visible (`lg:hidden` removed). The `unselected` state is removed because it is unreachable.
- `src/components/review-queue.tsx`: rewritten as the searchable, filterable table, using `useState` with no URL sync. Columns, badge variants, the row overlay link, the two Empty states, Reset and "Showing X of Y" follow the spec. Loading and access-error behaviour is unchanged.
- `src/app/review/loading.tsx`: skeleton for the list page with heading, toolbar and a bordered table block of Skeleton rows.
- `src/components/ui/table.tsx` and `src/components/ui/empty.tsx`: added via `npx shadcn@latest add table empty`. `package.json` and the lockfile are unchanged, so there are no new deps.

**Checks**
- `tests/review.ts` runs and exits 0 without a database.
- `tests/review.spec.ts` needs `E2E_BASE_URL`, `TEST_DATABASE_URL` and `E2E_GOOGLE_STORAGE_STATE`, so I did not run it.

**Deviations and notes**
- The status filter lists only statuses present in the data, each with its count. "All statuses" has no count.
- Search also matches the full "Given Family" string, so a query like "Ada Love" matches.
- ReviewRequest still has `if (!id) return;` guards. They are now redundant but harmless, so I left them to keep the diff small.
- The `after:absolute after:inset-0` overlay relies on a positioned `<tr>`, which modern browsers support. I have not verified it visually.
- `lg:overflow-y-auto` remains on the sections in both components. It is a leftover from the split pane and could be dropped in a follow-up.
